description: This file contains the main entry point and primary widget setup for a Flutter-based implementation of the 2048 game. It defines the root application widget, a placeholder home screen layout, score display components, and a grid placeholder for the game board.

classes.name: _PlaceholderHome
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing a placeholder main page with layout for score badges, game board placeholder, and control buttons.

classes.name: _ScoreBadge
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a labeled score value within a styled container.

classes.name: _BoardPlaceholders
classes.description: A StatelessWidget rendering a 4x4 grid of placeholder cells for the game board.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The application's entry point that initializes and runs the Flutter app with MyApp as the root widget.
